verdict.rationale: The only evidence of autonomous background behavior is the installable Linear agent, which answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory without manual invocation. Data-source integrations and GitHub org indexing suggest ongoing ingestion, but nothing documents user-configurable automations, triggers or recurring schedules. Every other cited operation (remember, improve, recall, forget, CLI) is a one-off action. Missing for 10: user-defined automation or workflow configuration, recurring or scheduled background jobs (e.g., periodic sync or improve), event triggers beyond the Linear agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Install Cognee as a Linear agent that answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory, and index the workspace's issues.
Connect a GitHub organization and index every covered repository into the code graph.
